description: `--after C` on `cli run list` (it is a `cli run watch` option) suggests `--before C`.

stderr.text:
OpenProse: INVOCATION_INVALID: Unknown option.
Detail: unknown option --after for `cli run list`; did you mean --before? It takes the cursor a previous page returned in result.nextBefore
Action: Replace --after with --before, which takes the previous page's result.nextBefore: `prose cli run list --before c1`.
